title: dlq.entry v1
owner: audit_log trigger on action 'dead-letter' (the fact is recorded by the dispatcher; the ledger announces it)
invariants: An event no officer could handle after retries. Its consumer is the Herald; its destination is the editor — by definition, an escalation. Field names follow the canonical Conclave DLQEntry (vitruvyan-core, transport/dlq.py) so a reader fluent in one bus reads the other; idempotency_key is sha256(channel:ENVELOPE event_id:group) truncated — the envelope id, not the Redis entry id, so a relay re-ship of the same logical event yields the same key.
